title: Passkey confirmation request
description: What basalt passkey confirm and reject put in the confirm page link: <base>/passkeys/confirm#1.<base64url(this JSON)>. The page shows the parsed binding (person, level, fingerprint, expiry), asks for a passkey from credentialIds, and outputs a confirm response. CONTRACT.md, Access and audit, People and passkeys.

binding.description: The full binding text from passkey_binding.

credentialIds.description: Active passkeys of the page's origin that may be trusted for the level: ADMIN ones, and the level's own once it has one. Postgres decides; this only fills allowCredentials.
